exposure: Time period (pre-vaccination, early post-vaccination, late post-vaccination)
cohort: The study participants were 297 COVID PCR-positive symptomatic patients who underwent cesarean sections.
finding: COVID-19 vaccination significantly reduced maternal ARDS, ICU admission, and mortality rates among PCR-positive symptomatic pregnant individuals undergoing cesarean sections, with the Delta variant being associated with higher rates of ICU admission and mortality.
